task: Create a JSON configuration object for an AWS S3 bucket lifecycle policy that deletes objects older than 90 days and transitions objects to Glacier after 30 days
solution_criteria: Valid JSON with correct structure for AWS S3 Lifecycle configuration, includes Rules array with Transitions and Expiration properties, correct DayThreshold values (30 for Glacier, 90 for Deletion), and proper StorageClass specification

task: Write a Python function that takes an AWS CloudWatch log message and extracts the timestamp, log level, and error message using regex pattern matching
solution_criteria: Function accepts a log string parameter, uses regex to parse timestamp (ISO 8601 format), log level (ERROR, WARN, INFO, DEBUG), and message content, returns a dictionary or tuple with extracted values, handles edge cases gracefully

task: Create a regular expression that validates AWS IAM role ARNs in the standard format (arn:aws:iam::account-id:role/role-name)
solution_criteria: Regex pattern correctly validates ARN structure with proper account ID (12 digits), role path separators, alphanumeric characters with hyphens and underscores, rejects invalid formats, and is case-sensitive for 'arn:aws:iam' prefix
